svg.title: Women's Class B blue blouse, short sleeve: Honor Guard white parade gloves (folded under the belt or the flag sling) (overlay, registered to garment-blues-class-b-blouse-female)

g.title: The white gloves not worn, folded with the palm out and placed under the web belt so that their tops fold over the top of the belt (CAPR 39-1 9.6.7.7), on the wearer's left of the buckle, fingers down, as the guidance figure draws them

The same folded gloves under the flag bearer's sling, at the same place: the tops fold over the upper edge of the waist band. The guidance draws no sling on the short sleeve figure: placed by analogy. Hidden in the file; the builder shows it, and hides gloves-under-belt, for the flag bearer
